title: Problems, until they're fixed
summary: With the app open, you switch Reports on but don't finish its setup, so the server lists it as a problem, saying how to fix it. GitHub then rejects the token you give, and the problem says so. A good token fixes it, and the problem clears on its own.

problems.title: Reports needs setting up
problems.detail: It's switched on, but its setup isn't finished, so it can't do anything yet.
problems.fix: Finish its setup in Settings › Capabilities › Reports, or switch it off.
